summary: Iter 55 — Two-fix verification PASSED. (A) /api/auth/register VIP first_1000 auto-grant: new signups receive the VIP badge with source='first_1000' when current_holders < first_x, are gated when cap is reached, and registration remains safe (no 500) when VIP badge status is 'draft'. (B) Music/Podcasts profile widgets: pinned sounds render via PlayableSoundRow wrapping SoundPlayerCard (real <audio> element, readyState=4), picker portals to document.body (parentTag='BODY'), owner-only X remove button works, public viewer never sees X. Podcasts category endpoint accepts podcast/Podcast/PODCASTS/podcasts/Podcasts — all 200. Backend regression: 12/12 phase31+phase32 tests still pass. New iter55 test suite: 9/9 pass.
action_items: OPTIONAL: legacy `is_vip` flag on /register is still set by raw `current_count < VIP_CUTOFF` (auth.py L59-60) independent of badge_registry cap. This means when VIP badge auto_rule is full (current_holders >= first_x) but total users < VIP_CUTOFF, the new user's badge is correctly skipped but `user.is_vip` is still True via the legacy path. Either tighten the legacy path to derive `is_vip` ONLY from the badge_registry, or document the split. Not a regression — same behavior shipped previously.

OPTIONAL: PlayableSoundRow click target — clicking the first <button> inside the row toggles the SoundPlayerCard's internal play state, but the <audio> element remained paused (readyState=4 confirmed source loaded; autoplay blocked by browser policy in the absence of a recognised user-gesture-on-audio). End users tapping the visible play icon will work because it's a direct user gesture on the dedicated play control. Consider adding a data-testid='sound-play-toggle' on the inner play button to simplify future automated playback tests.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: VIP auto-grant wrapped in try/except logger.exception — registration never 500s on badge hiccups (verified via draft-status test).
GOOD: $setOnInsert + upsert=True on user_badges keeps the assignment idempotent — safe even if /reconcile races with registration.
GOOD: Mirrors is_vip + vip_joined_at on user doc inside the success branch — keeps legacy `is_vip` checks consistent for first_1000 cohort.
GOOD: /api/sounds/by-user case-insensitive normalisation (sounds.py L724-732) — maps podcast/Podcast/PODCASTS→Podcasts before query, returns 400 only for true invalid categories.

GOOD: SoundPicker portals to document.body via createPortal (ProfileWidgetBodies.jsx L619-667) — solves the dnd-kit transform issue that previously trapped fixed-position backdrop inside the widget card.

GOOD: PlayableSoundRow conditionally renders the X remove button only when (editing && isOwner) — public viewers cannot trigger removal even on owner's own profile in non-edit mode (verified: x_remove=0 on /profile/stealth public view).

NIT: Legacy `is_vip = current_count < VIP_CUTOFF` in /register (L60) duplicates the role of the new badge auto-grant. Worth consolidating: derive is_vip from badge_registry only and drop the count check.
